content.value: A series motor has a resistance of 1Ω between its terminals. The motor runs at 800 rpm at 200V taking a current of 15A. Calculate the speed at which the motor will run when connected in series with a 5Ω resistance and taking the same current at the same supply voltage.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
